svg.title: ID-JAG vs AAuth: two ways to authorize an AI agent

g.text: Two ways to authorize an AI agent
IdP mints a short-lived grant for the
user's agent, and the resource's auth
server swaps it for an access token.
Admins set policy once, at the IdP.
signs every request with its own key.
When a resource wants more, a Person
Server gets the human's consent and
issues a token bound to that key.
The agent's own key, plus a Person
An HTTP signature and a key-bound token
IETF OAuth WG draft; MCP adopting
